_description: TY2025 FICA (Federal Insurance Contributions Act) wage bases and rates. Used for (a) computing employer-correct FICA when a filer is NOT exempt, and (b) computing the Form 843 refund amount when a NRA on F/J/M/Q visa had FICA incorrectly withheld during their exempt period. NRAs on F-1, J-1, M-1, or Q-1 visas performing services within their visa-authorized purpose are exempt under IRC §3121(b)(19). Source: SSA Press Release Oct 10 2024; IRS Notice on Additional Medicare Tax.
_source: SSA 2025 Cost-of-Living Adjustment release (Oct 2024); IRC §3121(a); IRC §1401(b)(2)

medicare._note: No wage cap on regular Medicare. Additional Medicare 0.9% applies to wages above threshold (employee portion only; employer does not match).
